customManagers.description: Track Go for the 126 LINE. Each line is a separate product with its own UPSTREAM_VERSION and its own cap, so a line never jumps minor: 1.27 arrives as a new lines/127/ with its own manager, not by moving this one.

packageRules.description: The 126 line stays on 1.26.x. Not an automerge exception -- automerge is the family default (ship-if-green) and still applies; this only stops Renovate from walking the line onto a Go minor it was never built for.
